prompt: Challenge C115-CH1: Our anti-cheat system flags about 900 accounts a day but our manual review team can only process 200 — legitimate players are getting banned

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"One-class support vector machines can detect scripted clients in online game environments by learning from legitimate player behavior alone, achieving 81% F1 score with 4.3% false-positive rate on a dataset of 48,000 sessions using 22 behavioral metrics.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06623","field":"abstract","quote":"one-class support vector machines (OC-SVM) to a labelled telemetry dataset of 48,000 sessions"}]},{"text":"Isolation Forest algorithms perform unsupervised multivariate anomaly detection on high-frequency data streams without requiring labelled training data, outperforming univariate baselines by 18 percentage points on correlated deviations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06618","field":"abstract","quote":"Isolation Forest algorithm for unsupervised anomaly detection in such streams"}]},{"text":"Research focuses on data quality assurance and anomaly detection in distributed real-time systems, including cross-source consistency validation and practical pipeline reliability motivated by integration project experience.","sources":[{"id":"R0571","field":"bio","quote":"data quality assurance in distributed and real-time systems, with particular attention to API-mediated data flows, cross-source consistency validation, and anomaly detection"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has direct publications on bot detection in online games using machine learning [SYN-PUB-06623] and unsupervised anomaly detection on high-frequency telemetry [SYN-PUB-06618], both directly applicable to distinguishing legitimate players from cheaters at scale while reducing false positives."}
